people.name: Daniel Barrera Barrera
people.roleLabel: Former leader of a cocaine-trafficking syndicate; sentenced to 35 years for cocaine conspiracies

evidence.claim: DOJ states Barrera ran a cocaine-manufacturing and trafficking syndicate from Colombia from 1998 to 2010. This is historical conduct, not a present location.
